published_evidence.exploitation_evidence: The reward calculation did not correctly reflect the changes in the total points of the pool, affecting the user's rewards.
published_evidence.fix_strategy_evidence: Introduce the rewardPerTokenStored variable to track the reward distribution for each point.
published_evidence.root_cause_evidence: There is a lack of variables for tracking the reward distribution of each point.

   335 | 		This struct records the state of each staked S1 Citizen.

   343 | 			from the staker.

   345 | 			worth, thus determining its share of emissions. An S1 Citizen's base 
   346 | 			points are a function of the S1 Citizen's component Identity and any 
   347 | 			associated Vault multiplier. The base points are also multiplied by the 
   348 | 			timelock option chosen at the time of staking. The base points are 
   349 | 			supplemented in points calculations by the value of `stakedBytes`.
   350 | 		@param stakedVaultId The optional ID of the Vault, if there is one, that 
   351 | 			has been staked alongside this S1 Citizen. If `hasVault` is true, this 
   352 | 			value may be non-zero to indicate a staked but non-component Vault. If 
   353 | 			`hasVault` is true and this value is zero, that is indicative of an S1 
   354 | 			Citizen with a component Vault.
   355 | 		@param hasVault A boolean indicating whether or not this S1 Citizen has an 
   356 | 			associated Vault, whether that Vault is a component Vault assembled into 
   357 | 			the S1 Citizen or one that has been staked alongside the S1 Citizen.
   358 | 	*/

   360 | 		uint256 stakedBytes;
   361 | 		uint256 timelockEndTime;
   362 | 		uint256 points;
   363 | 		uint256 stakedVaultId;
   364 | 		bool hasVault;
   365 | 	}
